{{Top}}
A '''heat shield''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement that increased shielding against fire. The Mark I, II, III, & IV versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in protection.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> During the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], heat shields were often seen on [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] [[Drop pod/Legends|drop pods]]. These same shields were affixed to modified [[Tech 4 PDV]]s during [[Operation Death-Hunter]]. These modified vessels were designed to carry [[Death-Hunter Cyborg]]s and the shields allowed safe crash landings on worlds where the cyborgs were assigned.<ref name="DS">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref> [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[Y-4 Transport]] was equipped with a one-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] thick heat shield and layers of spray-on [[ablative coating]] to deal with heat resistance encountered during [[Planet/Legends|planetfall]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''KotOR II'']], this upgrade can be used on all types of armor, except robes.
